title: Vibrant Crunchy Saudi Arabian Eggplant Bake
description: A winey, crunchy, show-off Saudi Arabian dish featuring Sichuan pepper, salt-bake, and lacto-vegetarian friendly ingredients, perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the toasted Sichuan pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the eggplant slices with olive oil and season with the Sichuan pepper mixture.
Bake the eggplant slices in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the minced garlic until fragrant.
Add the red wine to the skillet and bring to a simmer, cooking until the liquid has reduced by half.
In a large bowl, combine the baked eggplant slices, crumbled feta cheese, and chopped parsley.
Pour the garlic and red wine mixture over the eggplant mixture and toss to combine.
Transfer the eggplant mixture to a baking dish and top with crushed pita bread.
Bake in the preheated oven for an additional 15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and crunchy.
